en: A sepia-toned ethnographic postcard showing a large group of African people—men, women, and children—posed outdoors in front of round thatched huts. Many are standing while others sit or crouch in the foreground, some with woven materials or palm fronds laid on the ground. The setting appears to be a rural village, with trees on the left and several conical-roof huts in the background. At the top of the image there is printed text in Portuguese.
